en.label: Prerequisites:
en.content: not State Bachelor Examination
Introduction to the subject. Basic definitions and terms. History of paper production (allowance 2/0)
Wooden raw material - requirements for pulp and paper production, wood construction, chemical composition of wood (allowance 2/0)
Pulp production (white, brown, refined), semi-pulp production (allowance 2/0)
Pulp production by sulphite method (allowance 2/3)
Pulp production by sulphate method (allowance 2/3)
Preparation of pulp - grinding, sorting, filling, gluing, dyeing (allowance 2/0)
Sheet creation on a horizontal and cylindrical paper machine. Production of cartons and cardboards (allowance 2/0)
Overview of paper industry products. Printing papers, cardboards, cardboards and their ability to print. (allowance 2/0)
Mechanical and physical properties of paper, cardboard and paperboard (allowance 2/2)
Testing Methods of physical and mechanical properties (allowance 2/2)
Water management and wastewater treatment (allowance 2/0)
Preparation for the main exercise - excursion to the production plant (allowance 2/0)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of this subject is to gain knowledge about the various types of fibers, methods of their production, the technology of paper, cardboard and board production, the range of paper products and test methods for testing the properties of paper products.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to the subject. Basic definitions and terms. History of paper production (allowance 2/0)2.Wooden raw material - requirements for pulp and paper production, wood construction, chemical composition of wood (allowance 2/0)3.Pulp production (white, brown, refined), semi-pulp production (allowance 2/0)4.Pulp production by sulphite method (allowance 2/3)5.Pulp production by sulphate method (allowance 2/3)6.Preparation of pulp - grinding, sorting, filling, gluing, dyeing (allowance 2/0)7.Sheet creation on a horizontal and cylindrical paper machine. Production of cartons and cardboards (allowance 2/0)8.Overview of paper industry products. Printing papers, cardboards, cardboards and their ability to print.
